supersession_reason: A special expression should be a coordinated face pose plus a small semantic accent, not either layer alone.
purpose: Core special-function source art only. The face is visibly special and the accent reinforces its action. This is not a runtime resource, CRIG, profile, firmware binding, or panel claim.
identity_invariants: same V9 open-eye silhouette, pupil fills, one primary highlight and one small sparkle per eye
same eye pair scale, spacing, baseline and nose anchor as the locked V9 reference
no new eye shape, eyelash, iris color, text, UI panel, button, battery icon, plug, lightning icon, microphone icon or menu icon
the face and the accent must both be separable source components
removing the accent leaves a recognizably special facial emotion; removing the facial changes leaves no claim of a completed functional state
monochrome black ink on a clean white background with every ink component inside a 200x200 export-safe face area

poses.face: Quiet, composed thinking: focused but soft brows, a compact asymmetric thinking mouth and calm close cheek dots. The face is visibly different from Daily before seeing any other mark.
poses.accent: Exactly three tiny detached thinking dots above the face. They are a bounded secondary rhythm, not a menu icon or UI control.
poses.choreography_intent: Daily highlight pickup, brow focus, mouth settle, one three-dot beat, then causal reverse on menu exit.

poses.face: Gentle attentive listening: brows draw slightly toward calm concentration, mouth becomes a small closed focus mark and cheeks become subtly alert. The face is visibly different from Daily before seeing any other mark.
poses.accent: Two small symmetric detached listening ripple arcs outside the cheeks. They are a bounded secondary beat, not a microphone or waveform UI.
poses.choreography_intent: Legal highlight shift, attentive brow/mouth settle, one symmetric ripple beat, then causal reverse on stop or cancel.

poses.face: Restful replenishing contentment: relaxed gently lifted brows, a small rounded satisfied smile and buoyant cheeks. The face is visibly different from Daily before seeing any other mark.
poses.accent: One tiny centered detached two-part breathing arc above the face. It is a slow replenishing rhythm, not a battery, plug or lightning symbol.
poses.choreography_intent: Soften legal highlights and brows, settle the content mouth, one slow breathing-arc pulse, then causal reverse when unplugged.

required_followup: generate one source image per pose using the locked V9 reference
write generated-source hashes and exact prompt lineage before any crop or export
reject a source if its face remains Daily or if the accent reads as a UI/status widget
extract only source components, reassemble deterministic 200x200 PBM frames and verify identity geometry
run browser/target component-plan parity and canonical owner-art review
keep runtime_resource_activated false until the physical White and Black gates pass
